Pie Dough Bx1 x Grape Pie Wedding Crasher
-------------
Breakwater Small Batch is a series of limited releases created to bring you closer to our strain selection process. This project gives you the opportunity to explore strains that are still being evaluated for large scale production. Some of these strains may even return to our menu.
-------------
Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different.

Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole.

Opening a jar of our flower phenotype, Grape Crepe #61, launches a purple wave of grape juice and grape candy streaked with a subtle gassy note – an aroma that translates impeccably to flavor with vaporization or combustion. A balanced combination of stress-melting relaxation and uplifting euphoria is consistent with its lineage of Pie Dough, Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Purple Punch.

126.desc:
Lemon Tree Punch is a captivating hybrid strain crafted by Greenpoint Seeds, born from the flavorful cross of Lemon Tree and Purple Punch. This exceptional blend marries the sweet-and-sour zest of Lemon Tree with the fruity fragrance of Purple Punch, resulting in a rich and complex flavor profile. Strong notes of lemon, grape, and berry dominate the aroma, intertwined with subtle hints of diesel and earthy undertones. Depending on the phenotype, some expressions may highlight the grape and berry flavors, while others emphasize the citrusy essence, offering a unique experience with each taste.
The strain's primary terpenes include Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Linalool, and Bisabolol, contributing to its multifaceted flavors and effects. Limonene imparts a bright citrus flavor and is associated with uplifting mood and energy. Humulene and Myrcene add earthy and herbal nuances, promoting a sense of calm and relaxation. Linalool introduces gentle floral notes, enhancing the overall aromatic experience. Together, these terpenes create a harmonious balance that is both invigorating and soothing.
Lemon Tree Punch offers a balanced effect that is both stimulating and comforting. Users report that in small doses, it may boost mood and increase motivation, providing a gentle cerebral uplift that enhances focus and creativity. When consumed in larger quantities, the invigorating sensation shifts into a mellow relaxation, soothing the mind and fostering a peaceful state. Despite the calming body effects, the mind remains clear and functional. This versatile hybrid is ideal for those seeking to elevate their spirits during the day or unwind in the evening, making it a great all-day choice.
Strain Type: Hybrid
Lineage: [Lemon Tree] x [Purple Punch]
Breeder: Greenpoint Seeds

Strawberry Pie x Grape Cream Cake F2
-------------
Making its way to Breakwater from Terp Wizard, a Michigan regenerative farmer/caregiver, Strawberry Jelly is a cross of a Strawberry Pie mother pollinated by Grape Cream Cake f2 (both from Bloom Seed Co.). 

Terp Wizard selected the father of this cross for a few traits noticed early on, such as vigorous growth, good internodal spacing, and a stem rub that smelled exactly like its name, Grape Cream Cake. The appeal of the mother, Strawberry Pie (a cross of Strawberry Banana and Grape Pie Wedding Crasher), lay in her rich strawberry candy aroma, accented with a cheesy finish. The parents seemed like a natural fit and created offspring with a wide range of strawberry aromas, from strawberry menthol to strawberry and sour yogurt to strawberry kush.

Our flower phenotype, Strawberry Jelly #20, is astonishingly similar to our hash phenotype, delivering a healthy serving of sweet, slightly floral strawberry jam. A bit of grape can be detected as well, a sign of the strong paternal genetics. Aroma transitions elegantly to flavor with strawberry again at the forefront. A floral red berry and mildly cheesy grape jam flavor linger. Strawberry Jelly #20 offers versatile relief, with a calming, sociable, and euphoric experience suitable for anytime use."

Fruit-forward cannabis strains have dominated the market in the current cannabis climate, often at the expense of other flavors. However, at Breakwater, our cultivators are passionate about exploring this plant’s limitless diversity, relentlessly seeking out flavors of times past that speak to the complex history of cannabis. For this reason, Sour Super Skunk is a meaningful selection for us, preserving and expressing its own unique chapter in that history.

If there is one thing East Coast cannabis has been recognized for, it’s the gas profiles and Sour varieties. Sour Super Skunk, from Top Dawg Seeds, evokes memories of 1990s NYC and the age of Sour and Skunk. We carefully combed through nearly a thousand seeds with a Sour lineage before finally landing on this stalwart classic. Nose-hair-tingling, eye-burning, mouth-watering, sulphury sour and skunk aromas are in full effect with this phenotype. These aromas bring us back to a time when cannabis was still outlawed and heavily stigmatized. As such, quality Sour and Skunk varietals have been hard to track down. Critical genetic preservation has made it possible to rediscover plants that some have sworn were lost forever. We thank JJ of Top Dawg for this valuable contribution.

Large, chunky Sour Diesel shaped buds fill the canopy and the air with acrid tartness. The cured flower releases notes of gas, sour, and a gentle sweetness. Back-alley New York City terps smack you in the face as soon as the lid lifts from the jar. The live hash rosin packs its own unique punch with all the sour and skunk one could need. Effects are versatile and can range from uplifting and energizing to heavy-eyed, couch-locking, sedative effects–depending on the person, mood, and time of day.
